name: Rhino Whisky
verdict: A small South African single-malt brand founded by Gerrit Wagener and Brin Kushner. Nothing found.
note: Official whisky partner of Southern Guards GC (rwhisky.com: 'Rhino Whisky is proud to be the official Whisky of choice for the Southern Guards GC', opened 2026-10-03; also on livgolf.com/southern-guards-gc). Self-owned venture of its two founders per 2022 press (aspirelifestyle.co.za, whiskyoftheweek.co.uk); no company register extract or outside investor was found, so shareholdings are undocumented. The whisky is contract-distilled in Speyside, Scotland.
